description: Solar Potential is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Renewable energy, Resource assessments", published or maintained by Offgrid Market Opportunities. Global Horizontal Irradiance in Kwh / m2 for Nigeria, Tanzania and Zambia. The original data was provided by KTH. Coverage: Nigeria, Tanzania, Zambia. It has 2 files in GeoJSON, TILE. The portal files it under Renewable energy, Resource assessments, Solar. The portal gives 2016 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
